inventory.scope: all declarations in the selected program and transitive canonical source imports; no cfg pruning, call reachability, inferred types or target-support claim

rust_evidence.status: complete split Rust gate passed; primary totals exclude supplemental reruns

locals.scope: Execute explicit/inferred locals, immutable snapshots, mutable slots and shadowing; reject unresolved and immutable targets. Qualified paths need imports/records groups too.

arithmetic.scope: Exact independent formula bytes and executed Goldilocks values; decimal overflow and typed operator rejection. This does not admit U32 addition.

control.scope: Execute branches, boolean equality, block tails, discarded expressions and early returns; typecheck unselected arms and continuation coverage.

calls.scope: Execute fresh frames and ordered arguments; final declarations determine callable identity; recursion is rejected. Required two-parameter/helper-main regressions are explicit receipt cases.

u32.scope: Unsigned comparisons/masks and checked Field/U32 conversion; out-of-range conversion is a separate runtime trap, not a compiler rejection.

loops.scope: Inventory no_explicit_bound means no bounded annotation, not an unbounded loop: source uses literal ranges. Empty bodies and bounds are checked; these cases do not prove complete compiler-loop cost.

noun.scope: Whole structured values are compared; projection failures are additionally executed runtime traps.

digest.scope: All four identity limbs and dynamic Field/U32 indices are exercised, including complete noun output. Array indexing is separately mapped.

tuples.scope: Typed whole tuples, nested destructuring and ordered simultaneous assignment; preserve evaluation once and reject tuple/type/target mismatch.

records.scope: Inventory place.variable/expr.variable also contain dotted paths; compound-base expr.field is not the whole field-access count. Nominal identity, ordered layout and persistent updates are exercised.

arrays.scope: Only literal-extent Field arrays are in this closure. Dynamic reads execute; static invalid raw indices, mismatched extents and element writes reject. No generic/other-element array support inferred.

constants.scope: Final typed constants freeze before bodies; foreign literal provenance and owner spans survive imports. Replaced/unused bad declarations still reject.

modules.scope: Full guest jobs resolve direct imports and private implementation helpers across original MOD1 sources. Graph/header component evidence is supplemental, not a substitute for emitted-program execution.

contracts.scope: Accepted meaning is balanced lexical metadata, intentionally neither predicate typechecking nor runtime/proof enforcement. This narrower subset must remain explicit.

pure.scope: Purity uses documented source-member IO names and belongs to each declaration; no transitive purity/proof claim.

intrinsics.scope: Exact three VM files exercise ten lowerable declarations and admit five unused known-only declarations. Per-identity entries below explicitly distinguish unused acceptance from executable lowering.

chunk_boundaries_preserve_every_byte_cla.scope: Rust-built lexer component; token equivalence and frame bounds, not an extra semantic-corpus observation

full_source_trivia_reaches_eof_and_final.scope: Rust-built lexer component; token equivalence and frame bounds, not an extra semantic-corpus observation

module_graph.scope: Guest graph only; no emitted program.

intrinsic_abi.scope: Guest ABI component exhausts registered parameter/return shapes; this does not execute each intrinsic.

long_source.scope: Source span identity and long names, distinct from full-closure compilation.

runtime_traps.scope: Rejection here means emitted-program runtime failure, not source compilation failure.

bounded_trivia_scanning.scope: Existing-frame-bound source scanning and exact baseline token comparison, including newline at chunk end
